title: jó/rossz vmiben: Good or Bad at a Subject

sections.title: A skill area takes -ban/-ben
sections.content: To say you're good or bad AT a subject, use the adjective jó or rossz plus the subject in -ban/-ben — the same inessive ending you already use for "in" a place, just applied here to a skill area instead of somewhere physical.

items.spanish: Jó vagyok matematikában, de rossz vagyok történelemben.
items.english: I'm good at math, but I'm bad at history.
He/she is very good at biology.

sections.content: Don't mix this up with jól ("well"): jó vagyok matematikában uses the ADJECTIVE jó plus -ban/-ben on the subject, not the adverb jól.
